excluded_infrastructure_incidents.reason: Git Bash failed to start under the Codex Windows restricted process token: NtCreateDirectoryObject returned 0xC0000022. No final tests ran. Broker stopped and driver interrupted. Fresh cohort uses the same monitored Bash harness with sandbox escalation after a no-API health check.

limitations: Monitored local processes and heuristic command guards are not an OS filesystem/network sandbox.
Command matches report visible text attempts; they do not prove intent or exclude dynamically constructed access.
Input-field checks cannot prove absence of memorized training-data/reference leakage.
Final-test chronology uses native response timestamps and artifact mtimes with a two-second tolerance; it is not a tamper-proof event log.
API cost is recomputed from recorded native token usage and the experiment's explicit prices, not an invoice.
GPT prices are the explicit frozen experiment rates, not a billing invoice.
Candidate hashes and chronology expose visible post-generation changes; they are not a tamper-proof human-intervention log.
